model: Shared SingleTaskGP, Standardize outcomes, known fixed observation variances, CPU double
noise: Independent Gaussian, SD is a fraction of known analytic Pareto outcome ranges
arms: FPBI; NSGA-II fixed generations; NSGA-II generations rounded to FPBI queried decision-vector count (cap 300)
audit: Common output cap selected using posterior means; true analytic values and uncertainty audited outside generation timing/counters
limitations: Four analytic cases, three seeds, one machine with concurrent work; no BO trajectory, human-benefit or calibrated-safety claim. Known analytic ranges are used for benchmark normalization/capping.
